name: Black Fishnet Lace Bodystocking Jumpsuit
description:
Some looks start with the stockings — and this one-piece fishnet lace jumpsuit is the whole look in a single garment. The open mesh and floral-pattern lace run from shoulder to leg, so there is no top to hunt for, no briefs to match, nothing to coordinate. Step in, pull it on, and the outfit is done.

It comes in classic black and soft white, the two shades that flatter every skin tone under bedroom lighting and camera flash alike. Wear it on its own for boudoir nights, or layer it under an oversized shirt or an open blazer and let the fishnet texture do the talking at the edges.

The details, in plain terms:

  • Material: lace
  • Piece: full-set mesh outfit — jumpsuit cut, one piece
  • Features: open fishnet with lace pattern
  • Color: black or white
  • Size: one size, recommended for 40–70 kg (about 88–154 lb)

One garment, full coverage of the brief — that is the whole point of a bodystocking.
short_description: One-piece black or white fishnet lace bodystocking jumpsuit — a full mesh outfit that turns a single garment into the whole look.
